project_type: Python CLI tool for browser automation (Playwright-based job application bot)
build_system: pip with pyproject.toml, pyenv for Python version management
verification_instructions: 1. Set pyenv local to 3.11.15. 2. Create venv and install deps. 3. Run pytest tests/. 4. Run `python -m naukri_apply --help` to verify CLI works.
setup_instructions: pyenv local 3.11.15 && python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -e '.[dev]'
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Can install all packages. Playwright browsers can be installed via `playwright install chromium`.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - no prior conventions. Establish clean modular structure.
key_patterns: Modular design: separate modules for config, authentication, job application logic (easy apply vs external), form filling, CSV logging, and CLI entry point. Use dataclasses/Pydantic for structured data. Async Playwright for browser automation.
directory_structure: src/naukri_apply/ - main package with modular components. tests/ - pytest test suite. Root has pyproject.toml, README.md, config examples.
